title: How We Work
subtitle: What to expect at every stage
description: No chaos or unexpected surprises. We agree on every stage with you and regularly show you the progress.

analysis.title: Discuss the Task
analysis.description: We understand how your processes work today, identify the problems, and define the result you want to achieve.

design.title: Design the Solution
design.description: We plan the structure of the future product, user workflows, and technical architecture.

development.title: Build
development.description: We develop the product step by step and regularly show you the progress.

testing.title: Test
testing.description: We test all functionality, fix issues, and prepare the project for launch.

deploy.title: Launch
deploy.description: We deploy the project to the server, connect the necessary services, and hand over access credentials.

support.title: Keep Improving
support.description: After launch, we stay available to help develop the product and add new functionality.
